caption: The video showcases a luminous scene in which broad, fan-like beams of pale light descend from the upper edge of the frame toward a churning layer of white vapor that already billows along the bottom. The beams radiate downward in soft, diverging shafts that hold their orientation, while the mist beneath them forms rounded, cloud-like masses that glow brightest where the light strikes their upper surfaces. Over time this vapor steadily climbs and thickens. At the opening the band is low and wispy, with thin tendrils curling on the right, and it swells into a dense bank that rises in the middle, evens out, and swallows the lower reaches of the light shafts as the right-side wisps are absorbed. The rising mass presses against the beams, dimming their bases while the upper portions remain clear, and the covered height of the layer increases. The texture of the mist shifts continuously, its surface folding and swirling as it ascends. The beams themselves keep their orientation and brightness, acting as a steady backdrop to the restless, rising vapor that continues to climb.
